newsitem.title: USA: A.G. Edwards sees tough comparison with '96.
newsitem.headline: A.G. Edwards sees tough comparison with '96.

text.p: A.G. Edwards Inc, which reported higher revenues but lower earnings for the fiscal first quarter, said it faces tough comparisons with last year's results.
"Business continues good, but last year's record pace will continue to provide us with tough comparisons," Benjamin Edwards III, chairman, said in a statement.
In fiscal 1997 ended February 28, the financial services company earned $3.36 a share on revenues of $1.7 billion.
It reported earnings for the first quarter ended May 31 of $0.83 a share, down from $0.87 last year. Revenues were $439.3 million, up from $428.5 million.

"Our first quarter of fiscal 1998 was our third best ever," Edwards said. "However, net earnings were lower than last year's first quarter and both revenues and net earnings declined from our previous quarter."
